llm.summary: The skill is a coherent read-only Zhihu data helper, but it repeatedly tells agents to run an unpinned npm package at runtime while exposing the SocialDataX API key to that process.

dimensions.detail: The skill requires `SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY` and runs a remotely fetched Node package, meaning that package receives sensitive credential access under the agent's local execution permissions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The preferred CLI examples repeatedly use `npx -y socialdatax-skills@latest`, so execution depends on mutable remote npm code rather than a pinned reviewed version.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are mostly scoped to read-only Zhihu data retrieval, but troubleshooting allows automatic dependency installation or restoration when the environment has permission.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact does not request persistence, services, scheduled tasks, browser/session data, login, posting, liking, commenting, or account mutation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Zhihu hot-list, search, content detail, comments, replies, and creator research through SocialDataX, and the documented commands match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable letting a dynamically fetched npm package use your SocialDataX API key. Prefer a pinned, reviewed package version or a controlled local installation before use, and avoid granting broad local execution permissions unnecessarily.
llm.findings: [RP1] expected: A CLI package is expected for this integration, but the artifact-backed concern is valid because all examples use `socialdatax-skills@latest` through `npx`, making the executed code changeable after review while using the API key.
